text:
Emma: Quick sync 10am PT launch plan. Need: short X copy, 1 long LinkedIn post, 6-tweet X thread, 3 images. Target: tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Jamal: Share pillars so I can draft copy.
Emma: Pillars = predictable low-latency inference; cost controls (batching + quant); unified deploy (hosted/dedicated/private). Tone: technical but friendly.
Kevin: Images: hero, latency-vs-cost chart, 3-card carousel (tips). I can mock hero+chart; need locked copy to finish.
Maria: Ill take LinkedIn longform. Add placeholder customer quote: [QUOTE_PLACEHOLDER] "Redwood cut inference costs 3x without sacrificing latency".
Emma: Add UTMs to all links: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_medium=social.
Jamal: Draft X short: "Predictable inference, at scale. Deploy across hosted, reserved, or private infra without guesswork. link" Need CTA A/B: "See benchmarks" vs "Start free trial"?
Kevin: A/B both. Tweet A -> "See benchmarks"; B -> "Start free trial". Rotate audiences.
Maria: LinkedIn opener draft: "Shipping LLM features is easy. Shipping them reliably and affordably? Not so much. Today were launching Redwood Inference  a runtime + control plane to make inference predictable across environments. Heres how we cut unit cost and latency: [bullets]."
Emma: Jamal, sketch 6-tweet thread: hook, problem, tech (batch/cache), deploy options, benchmark tease, CTA+signup link. Keep each <280 chars.
Jamal: Thread sketch:
1/ "Deploying LLMs shouldnt be a gamble. Heres how we made inference predictable."
2/ "Problem: variance in latency & cost breaks product trust. Teams need steady tail latency and predictable unit economics."
3/ "Tech: auto-batching, prefix KV caching, quant profiles; pick kernels per workload to keep latency tight."
4/ "Deploy: hosted API for fast onboarding, dedicated for throughput, private for regulated data  same API everywhere."
5/ "Benchmarks: ~2.5x cost reduction on chat workloads at p99 vs naive serving (details link)."
6/ "Try it: sign up for early access + benchmark pack -> link (with UTMs)."
Emma: Kevin, can you deliver hero.png, compare-chart.png, carousel-tips.png by EOD? Need alt text too.
Kevin: Will push to /designs/launch-mini/ by 6pm PT. Alt text: hero: "Redwood logo over server racks"; compare: "bar chart of latency vs cost"; carousel: "cards: batching, caching, quantization".
Maria: Engagement plan: pin top thread 6h after launch; 24h POV post with learnings + customer snippet; engineers on reply duty.
Emma: Growth should DM leads when >5 demo requests in replies. Add UTMs to signup link.
Jamal: Ill handle replies 10-12p PT launch day; Kevin covers 12-4p PT.
Maria: Scheduling note: post X at 10:00am PT, LinkedIn at 10:05am PT (crosspost to company).
social-bot: Scheduled post created: channel=#x, time=2026-04-01T10:00:00-07:00, id=post_90012.
Kevin: Can we include a small GIF showing batch pooling in carousel slot 2? 1.8s, <5MB.
Emma: Yes if <5MB.
Jamal: Final checklist: copy locked by 6pm; images uploaded by 6pm; UTMs confirmed; social scheduling locked; reply roster set.
Emma: I'll lock copy. Jamal/Maria confirm by 5:30pm PT.
Maria: Confirmed. Longform frozen at 5:15pm.
Jamal: Confirmed.
Emma: 15-min sync at 5:40pm PT to finalize.
